HistoryStampsCapability.RelHistoryStamps(id types.RelID) (txFrom, txTo types.Instant, has bool, err error)
obligations.required_v5_mapping: Current stamps describe the selected current row, including pending writes; history stamps fold maximum TxFrom and maximum TxTo/DeletedAt of retained history. Neither is a certified cut, global order or full-row integrity/completeness proof. Badger temporal-only decoding may answer a corrupt body; new/invalid versions and undecodable temporal blocks refuse. Tiered current reads follow one selected owner, while history walks retain the history door fold/dedup contract and now reuse routing probes. Only exact native stores or explicitly declared implementations may bypass row methods; inherited native/sharded wrapper capabilities must not bypass overrides. Retain retraction/source evidence from full rows.
required_tests: Node/relationship differential against full-row/history folds across pending insert/update/delete/reimport/retraction, compaction, archive/cold transitions and reopen.
Malformed ID, missing current with retained history, unsupported wire version, corrupt temporal/body distinction and errors.Is propagation.
Native/sharded wrappers preserve injected row policy/errors; stale nonowner copies do not alter current stamps.
obligations.ownership: rho exact access and preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption

obligations.required_v5_mapping: Current index membership lists are ascending and include pending writes, but may name an unreadable row; hydration must report that error. They are not historical answers. Effective label/type gathers widen IDs with ever-members/history and then resolve each candidate. Badger/sharded answer; memory/tiered use row fallback. Capability is offered only where label/type reads ignore depth; wrapper row overrides remain authoritative. Preserve historical label/type losses/deletes without duplicate decode just to gather IDs.
required_tests: Exact current ID sets/order equal row doors before/after pending membership changes, flush and reopen; unreadable index members fail during hydration.
Lost/gained historical labels and deleted/reimported relationship lives survive candidate widening at old pins; answering paths read each timeline candidate once.
Depth-scoped/unsupported and inherited-wrapper paths retain correct fallback and callback behavior.
obligations.ownership: rho exact access and preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption

contract: ClassifyScalar(v any) (k ColumnKind, i64 int64, f64 float64, s string, b bool, ok bool)
obligations.required_v5_mapping: Other identifies a held value outside Kinds[c], including scalar-kind mismatch, and also has Null=true plus a zero typed slot. It is not PropertyTypeClassCounts.Other. Re-read marked cells under the same temporal selection; nil Other on an unsupported optional RelColumnSource does not prove true absence. Other is nil for an all-scalar batch and otherwise rectangular/parallel to Null; markers reset across batches. All selected typed arrays have one slot per row, including leading/all absences. int8/int16/uint8/uint16/uint32 widen to int64; uint/uint64 above MaxInt64 follow v4 float64 snapshot normalization, never signed wrap; mixed numeric kinds refuse. Preserve original concrete row values separately from that lossy normalized projection.
required_tests: Node/relationship/segment and pinned/unpinned columns agree with row values for absent, present-null, lists/maps/custom structs and scalar mismatches; fallback keeps requested historical state.
Leading/all absences and 4096-row batch boundaries maintain typed/Null/Other alignment and borrowed buffer lifetime.

Every integer width including MaxInt64 boundary agrees across drivers; fitting/nonfitting uint mixture reports ErrMixedNumericColumn; optional source without Other remains compatible without a false completeness claim.
obligations.ownership: rho exact access and preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption

obligations.required_v5_mapping: All six doors stream per-entity effective state timelines at a source pin, with contiguous ascending segments and unmerged distinct row identities. Relationship timelines are DECLARED, never endpoint-life masked. All-entity/seeded scan entity order is unspecified; by-ID order is first occurrence in caller input, duplicates once, unknown/post-pin identities omitted. Multi-label selection is a union, not intersection. Seed directions are explicitly converted; invalid IDs/seeds/direction/type inputs refuse before segments, and pin/retention/compaction gates propagate. Callbacks run outside graph locks and false stops; per-entity snapshot isolation does not imply one atomic graph cut. Seed gather uses current adjacency plus ALL relationship history, preserving earlier endpoints after deleted-ID reimport; O(H) timeline work is explicit, not output-sensitive, and empty seeds avoid a history fold. Broader candidate optimization remains backlog 50. Upstream backlog 49 still records tiered cross-shard reimport making earlier history unreachable, and backlog 50 records older pinned adjacency omitting earlier endpoints; the new broad scan cannot recover history its per-entity reader cannot reach. Preserve/report source incompleteness instead of treating these known gaps as v5 semantics or repaired evidence.

evidence.anchor: upstream backlog 49/50 source-history and adjacency limitations

required_tests: Exact-set mutation-then-old-pin parity of all six doors against per-entity/state timeline oracle, with labels held only earlier, deleted nodes/relationships, retract/reimport and corrected intervals.
Seeded old endpoints across alive reimport, both directions, repeated seeds/IDs/labels, unknown IDs/types, empty seeds and declared/effective view distinction.
Callback reentry/early stop/isolation, concurrent writers above pin, per-entity retention/compaction refusal and errors.Is on invalid inputs/direction.
Measure narrow seeded gather separately from by-ID timelines before claiming useful access cost or scaling.
Cross-shard tiered reimport and earlier-endpoint pinned-adjacency reproduction must not silently certify complete source history; preserve ambiguity/evidence independently of a clean current read.
obligations.ownership: rho exact access and preservation; sigma/ai-soc adapter consumption
